items.headline: Expanded World Cup in Full Swing
items.body: The FIFA World Cup 2026, featuring an expanded format with 48 teams and 104 matches, is well underway across 16 venues in the United States, Canada, and Mexico. The tournament, which began on June 11, 2026, is currently navigating its group stage and transitioning into the newly introduced Round of 32.

items.headline: Philadelphia Prepares for Knockout Action
items.body: Philadelphia is buzzing as it prepares to host a Round of 16 match on July 4, 2026, coinciding with the United States' 250th-anniversary celebrations. The city is one of 11 U.S. host cities, with matches also taking place in Canada and Mexico.

items.headline: Round of 32 Battles Commence
items.body: With the group stage concluding, the tournament has transitioned into the Round of 32, a new addition to the expanded 48-team format. Teams are now facing single-elimination matches, where tactical discipline and clinical finishing become paramount.

items.headline: Physical Demands Test Squad Depth
items.body: The intense schedule of the World Cup, especially with the expanded format, is placing significant physical demands on players. Managing fatigue and minor injuries is crucial for teams looking to make a deep run in the tournament.
